Gallo pinto, plantains, handmade tortillas and black coffee before the sun clears the ridge.

Every morning across our 9-day expeditions begins at a table like this. Before 25 kilometres of mountain singletrack or 100 kilometres of peninsula gravel, breakfast is warm rice and beans, eggs, avocado and coffee grown in the valley you are about to cross.

On the Trail Running Expedition, the food follows you down the mountain: on the Queen Stage, families in La Chaqueta open their kitchens to hand runners agua dulce and hot empanadas. On the Hiking Expedition, meals come from family gardens and local trapiches at Armonía Ambiental and Los Campesinos.

The Trail Running Expedition · 9 days · 6 to 8 athletes. Departures: 5–13 December 2026, 20–28 February 2027, 7–15 August 2027. Details in the bio.
